limits: One instrumented operation/source/cell; not a distribution, gate, or causal intervention.
CPU weights are approximate sorted cumulative sample intervals; raw negative deltas preserved.
Inclusive stacks and nested timeline intervals overlap: never add categories or subtract to infer causes.
EventTiming may arrive after stop or omit unsupported/short events; absence is not zero cost.
Numerous negative raw CPU deltas limit interval-derived self weights; these are not exact native/component costs or additive causal explanations.
Profiler startup bookkeeping precedes the action; whole-profile totals include this and cannot be compared as app action cost.
Trace stack line/columns retained as received (usually1-based); CPU frames are0-based.
